So much to be thankful for. Health, wealth, family friends and many many more 

Health- I have taken health and wellness serious since I was a teenager and athlete. Now that I’m 41, I take it even more serious.  I workout 6 days a week (sometimes 7), eat a healthy diet of mostly fruits, vegetables and lean meats. I drink virtually zero alcohol and consume zero refined sugar.  It’s amazing what eating right and exercise will do for you and your energy level. Once you start eating right it becomes a lifestyle not a chore.  I would choose chicken/salmon with vegetables 7 days a week over fast food, pizza ect. Once you take that first step to health and wellness and see the results it will slowly become a lifestyle and not a chore. 

Wealth-(Not bragging, just very grateful)  incredibly blessed for my job/career. I have been addicted to the markets since I was in college and I’m so grateful in those early years of taking looses I choose to stick with it and not give up. Not only have I enjoyed and lived for trading I love to invest for the long term in both equities and land. Extremely grateful for what I have been able to build. (Again not bragging, just humble and grateful) 

Family- I have the best family I could imagine.  I was born with fantastic parents that always put us kids first and made sure we had whatever we needed to succeed.  I’m now married to the best woman I could imagine and have 2 awesome kids. The best part of my day is when the market closes (3pm in the midwest) and kids get home from school and we play some activity in the yard. Also my son who is 12, trades with me and loves to shares his own ideas. He’s getting pretty good but needs a lesson in risk management 😄

Friends- I have great friend both traders and non traders that I love to connect and stay in touch with. Great friends are definitely important to a well balanced life.  

In this life we have so much to be grateful for but unfortunately most of us (including me) take it for granted.
